points.title: 早年成长
points.description: 尼尔斯·玻尔1885年10月7日出生于哥本哈根的一个知识分子家庭。他的父亲克里斯蒂安·玻尔是哥本哈根大学的生理学教授，母亲艾伦·玻尔出身于富裕的犹太银行家家庭。玻尔从小在学术氛围浓厚的环境中成长，展现出对科学的浓厚兴趣。他在哥本哈根的语法学校接受基础教育，表现出卓越的数学和物理才能。这段家庭环境为他后来的科学成就奠定了坚实基础，也培养了他对哲学思考的浓厚兴趣。
points.descriptionEn: Niels Bohr was born on October 7, 1885, in Copenhagen into an intellectual family. His father, Christian Bohr, was a professor of physiology at the University of Copenhagen, and his mother Ellen Adler came from a wealthy Jewish banking family. Bohr grew up in a scholarly environment that nurtured his scientific interests. He received his early education at Copenhagen's grammar school, demonstrating exceptional talent in mathematics and physics. This family background laid the foundation for his later scientific achievements and cultivated his deep interest in philosophical thinking.

points.title: 学术奠基
points.description: 玻尔进入哥本哈根大学学习物理，师从著名物理学家克里斯蒂安·克里斯滕森。1909年获得硕士学位，1911年以金属电子理论的论文获得博士学位。在哥本哈根大学期间，他受到当时物理学界关于原子结构问题的启发，特别是J.J.汤姆逊的原子模型和卢瑟福的核式原子模型的影响。这段学术训练使玻尔掌握了经典物理学的基础，同时也开始质疑经典理论在微观世界的适用性，为他后来提出革命性的原子模型埋下伏笔。
points.descriptionEn: Bohr entered the University of Copenhagen to study physics, under the guidance of renowned physicist Christian Christiansen. He earned his master's degree in 1909 and his doctorate in 1911 with a thesis on the electron theory of metals. During his time at the university, he was inspired by contemporary atomic structure problems, particularly J.J. Thomson's atomic model and Rutherford's nuclear model. This academic training equipped him with a solid foundation in classical physics while simultaneously leading him to question its applicability in the microscopic world, laying the groundwork for his later revolutionary atomic model.

points.title: 英国深造
points.description: 获得博士学位后，玻尔前往英国剑桥大学卡文迪许实验室，在J.J.汤姆逊的指导下进行博士后研究。1912年，他转赴曼彻斯特，加入欧内斯特·卢瑟福的研究团队。在曼彻斯特期间，玻尔深入研究了卢瑟福的原子核模型，并开始发展自己的原子理论。他认识到经典物理学无法解释原子的稳定性，大胆提出量子化的概念。这段英国经历对玻尔科学思想的成熟至关重要，他吸收了当时最前沿的物理学思想，并开始形成自己独特的量子理论框架。
points.descriptionEn: After earning his doctorate, Bohr traveled to Cambridge University's Cavendish Laboratory, where he conducted postdoctoral research under J.J. Thomson. In 1912, he moved to Manchester to join Ernest Rutherford's research team. During his time in Manchester, Bohr studied Rutherford's nuclear atomic model intensively and began developing his own atomic theory. He recognized that classical physics could not explain atomic stability and boldly introduced the concept of quantization. This British experience was crucial to the maturation of Bohr's scientific thinking, as he absorbed the most advanced physics ideas of the time and began forming his unique quantum theoretical framework.

points.title: 量子理论奠基
points.description: 1916年，玻尔回到哥本哈根大学担任理论物理学教授。1920年，他创建了哥本哈根理论物理研究所（后改名为尼尔斯·玻尔研究所），并担任所长直至去世。在这期间，玻尔提出了革命性的玻尔原子模型（1913年），解释了氢原子光谱，为量子力学的发展奠定了基础。他提出了互补原理，成为量子力学哥本哈根学派的创始人。1922年，他因原子结构和原子辐射的研究获得诺贝尔物理学奖。在哥本哈根研究所，他吸引了包括海森堡、泡利、狄拉克等在内的众多顶尖物理学家，使这里成为世界量子物理学研究的中心。
points.descriptionEn: In 1916, Bohr returned to the University of Copenhagen as a professor of theoretical physics. In 1920, he founded the Institute for Theoretical Physics (later renamed the Niels Bohr Institute) and served as its director until his death. During this period, Bohr proposed his revolutionary atomic model (1913), explaining the hydrogen atom spectrum and laying the foundation for quantum mechanics development. He formulated the principle of complementarity and became the founder of the Copenhagen interpretation of quantum mechanics. In 1922, he was awarded the Nobel Prize in Physics for his work on atomic structure and radiation. At the Copenhagen Institute, he attracted many top physicists including Heisenberg, Pauli, and Dirac, making it a world center for quantum physics research.

points.title: 曼哈顿计划
points.description: 1939年，纳粹德国占领丹麦后，玻尔逃离丹麦前往美国。他在普林斯顿高等研究院工作，后来加入洛斯阿拉莫斯的曼哈顿计划，参与原子弹的研发。玻尔作为科学顾问，向奥本海默等人提供了关键的理论指导。他特别关注原子能的和平利用，并试图说服西方科学家与苏联科学家分享核技术，以防止核军备竞赛。这段经历使玻尔深刻认识到科学与社会、政治的复杂关系，促使他后来积极倡导科学家的社会责任和国际合作。
points.descriptionEn: In 1939, after Nazi Germany occupied Denmark, Bohr fled to the United States. He worked at the Institute for Advanced Study in Princeton and later joined the Manhattan Project at Los Alamos, participating in the development of the atomic bomb. As a scientific advisor, Bohr provided crucial theoretical guidance to figures like Oppenheimer. He was particularly concerned with the peaceful use of atomic energy and attempted to persuade Western scientists to share nuclear technology with their Soviet counterparts to prevent an arms race. This experience made Bohr deeply aware of the complex relationship between science and society/politics, leading him to later actively advocate for scientists' social responsibility and international cooperation.

points.title: 晚年贡献
points.description: 二战后，玻尔回到丹麦，继续领导尼尔斯·玻尔研究所。1955年，他参与创建了欧洲核子研究中心(CERN)。他积极倡导国际科学合作，特别是东西方科学家之间的交流。玻尔晚年致力于将量子力学与相对论统一，探索基本粒子的更深层次结构。他还深入研究了生物学问题，将量子概念应用于生命现象研究。1962年11月18日，玻尔在哥本哈根家中去世，享年77岁。他的葬礼成为丹麦国家大事，世界各国科学家和政要出席，表达对这位20世纪最伟大物理学家之一的敬意。
points.descriptionEn: After World War II, Bohr returned to Denmark and continued to lead the Niels Bohr Institute. In 1955, he helped establish the European Organization for Nuclear Research (CERN). He actively advocated for international scientific cooperation, particularly exchanges between Eastern and Western scientists. In his later years, Bohr worked toward unifying quantum mechanics with relativity and exploring the deeper structure of elementary particles. He also studied biological problems, applying quantum concepts to life phenomena. On November 18, 1962, Bohr died at his home in Copenhagen at age 77. His funeral became a major national event in Denmark, with scientists and political leaders from around the world attending to pay tribute to one of the 20th century's greatest physicists.

supporter.zh: 玻尔是量子物理学的奠基人之一，他的原子模型和互补原理彻底改变了人类对微观世界的理解。他创建的哥本哈根研究所成为世界物理学研究中心，培养了众多诺贝尔奖得主。玻尔不仅是一位杰出的科学家，也是一位深刻的思想家，他将科学探索与哲学思考完美结合。他晚年积极倡导科学家的社会责任和国际合作，为科学伦理的发展做出了重要贡献。玻尔的精神遗产激励着一代又一代科学家追求真理，他的思想至今仍在物理学和哲学领域产生深远影响。
supporter.en: Bohr was one of the founders of quantum physics, and his atomic model and principle of complementarity revolutionized human understanding of the microscopic world. The Copenhagen Institute he founded became a world center for physics research, nurturing numerous Nobel laureates. Bohr was not only an outstanding scientist but also a profound thinker who perfectly combined scientific exploration with philosophical reflection. In his later years, he actively advocated for scientists' social responsibility and international cooperation, making significant contributions to the development of scientific ethics. Bohr's intellectual legacy continues to inspire generations of scientists in their pursuit of truth, and his ideas still exert profound influence in physics and philosophy.

critic.zh: 玻尔的量子理论也面临诸多批评。他的互补原理被一些物理学家认为是模糊不清的哲学思辨而非严格的科学理论。他在曼哈顿计划中的角色也引发争议，有人认为他对原子弹的研发负有道德责任。玻尔对哥本哈根学派的强势领导有时被批评为压制了其他量子力学解释的发展。此外，他在核能和平利用方面的理想主义立场被认为过于天真，未能有效阻止核军备竞赛。这些批评反映了科学进步中的复杂性和科学家面临的道德困境。
critic.en: Bohr's quantum theory also faced significant criticism. His principle of complementarity was seen by some physicists as vague philosophical speculation rather than rigorous scientific theory. His role in the Manhattan Project also sparked controversy, with some arguing he bore moral responsibility for the development of the atomic bomb. Bohr's strong leadership of the Copenhagen School was sometimes criticized for suppressing the development of other quantum mechanical interpretations. Additionally, his idealistic stance on the peaceful use of nuclear energy was considered overly naive, failing to effectively prevent the nuclear arms race. These criticisms reflect the complexities of scientific progress and the moral dilemmas faced by scientists.

objective.zh: 在历史学界和流行文化中，玻尔被定义为20世纪科学革命的标志性人物。他不仅是量子物理学的奠基人，也是连接科学与人文的桥梁。玻尔的思想超越了纯物理学范畴，影响了哲学、认识论甚至政治思想。他的肖像出现在丹麦货币上，成为国家骄傲的象征。在流行文化中，玻尔常被描绘为一位兼具科学严谨性和哲学深度的智者形象。他的生平故事被多次改编成书籍、纪录片和戏剧，展现了科学探索与人类命运的深刻联系。玻尔已成为科学精神与人文关怀相结合的典范。
objective.en: In historical scholarship and popular culture, Bohr is defined as a pivotal figure of the 20th-century scientific revolution. He was not only a founder of quantum physics but also a bridge between science and humanities. Bohr's ideas transcended pure physics, influencing philosophy, epistemology, and even political thought. His portrait appears on Danish currency, symbolizing national pride. In popular culture, Bohr is often depicted as a sage combining scientific rigor with philosophical depth. His life story has been adapted into books, documentaries, and plays, illustrating the profound connection between scientific exploration and human destiny. Bohr has become a model of the integration of scientific spirit and humanistic concern.

self.zh: 预测非常困难，尤其是关于未来的预测。
self.en: Prediction is very difficult, especially about the future.

others.zh: 玻尔的思想如此深刻，以至于人们需要很长时间才能完全理解其含义。他不仅是一位伟大的物理学家，也是一位伟大的思想家。
others.en: Bohr's thoughts were so profound that it took a long time for people to fully grasp their implications. He was not only a great physicist but also a great thinker.
